platform_names: Your account [Help Center]; Users [settings]; Roles [settings]; Security [settings]; Logging in [Help Center]; How to Contact Shopify Support [Help Center]
plain_line: The Shopify account and the store owner, signing in and account security, staff users with their roles and permissions, collaborators from outside the store, checks on the identity of the people behind an account, and Shopify's own support and learning.

platform_names: Organization settings [Help Center]; Organization [settings]; Managing stores and organizations [Help Center]; Managing business entities [Help Center]; Expansion stores [Help Center]; Selling with multiple entities [other:help-center-sections]
plain_line: The organization that holds one or more stores, its expansion stores, and the business entities (individual, company or non-profit) a store sells as, including selling with more than one entity.

platform_names: Shopify admin [Help Center]; Activity logs in the Shopify admin [Help Center]; General [settings]; Notifications [settings]
plain_line: The admin itself: the store's general details, the log of what staff and apps did in the admin, and the notifications the store sends to customers and staff.
note: The Help Center's Shopify admin menu holds the activity logs; General and Notifications are separate settings pages with one concern each, joined here to keep the list short.

platform_names: Plan [settings]; Billing [settings]; Pricing plans [Help Center]; Managing your Shopify billing [Help Center]; Shopify Plus Terms [term]
plain_line: The subscription plans and their prices, Shopify's bills to the merchant and the taxes Shopify charges on them, transaction fees on sales through other payment providers, app charges billed through Shopify, and Shopify Plus contract terms and renewals.
note: Plan and Billing are separate settings pages, and the Help Center puts pricing plans under Intro to Shopify and billing under Your account; they are joined because the plan is what the bills charge for.

platform_names: Products [Help Center]; Products [admin-navigation]; Collections [admin-navigation]; Gift cards [admin-navigation]; Product bundles [Help Center]; Purchase options [Help Center]; Digital products [Help Center]; Dropshipping [Help Center]
plain_line: Products and variants, collections, combined listings, gift cards, bundles, upsells and pre-orders, subscriptions and other purchase options, custom and digital products, and sourcing products by dropshipping, print on demand or wholesale.

platform_names: Inventory and locations [Help Center]; Inventory [admin-navigation]; Purchase orders [admin-navigation]; Transfers [admin-navigation]; Locations [settings]
plain_line: Stock quantities, inventory transfers, shipments between locations and purchase orders, and the locations that hold stock.

platform_names: Online Store [Help Center]; Content [admin-navigation]; Custom data [Help Center]; Domains [Help Center]; Domains [settings]
plain_line: The online store: themes, pages and blog posts, menus, storefront search, files and custom data (metafields and metaobjects), hosting and SSL, domains, and apps for store design and for mobile apps.
note: Joins three Help Center menus (Online Store, Custom data, Domains) that all shape the storefront; Content in the admin already holds files, metaobjects, menus and blog posts together.

platform_names: Customers [Help Center]; Customers [admin-navigation]; Segments [admin-navigation]; Customer accounts [settings]; Store credit [Help Center]; Shopify Inbox [Help Center]
plain_line: Customer records and segments, customer accounts and the ways customers sign in, customers' marketing consent, store credit, customer account extensions, and talking with customers through Shopify Inbox and support apps.
note: Shopify Inbox is a Help Center menu of its own with one concern; it is joined to Customers, whose menu holds Providing online customer service.

platform_names: Shopify B2B [Help Center]; B2B [Help Center]; Companies [admin-navigation]; Catalogs [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Selling to businesses: companies with their locations and contacts, catalogs of products and prices, and payment terms.

platform_names: Shopify Checkout [Help Center]; Checkout [settings]; Abandoned checkouts [admin-navigation]; Store policies [Help Center]; Bot protection for sales [Help Center]
plain_line: The cart and Shopify Checkout: checkout settings and branding, checkout extensions and the functions that validate or change a cart, abandoned checkouts, bot protection, and the store policies shown at checkout.

platform_names: Orders [admin-navigation]; Drafts [admin-navigation]; Managing orders [Help Center]; Refunds [other:help-center-sections]
plain_line: Orders and draft orders, editing orders, refunds, returns and exchanges, and printing packing slips and other order documents.

platform_names: Shipping and delivery [settings]; Fulfilling orders [Help Center]; Shipping labels [admin-navigation]; Fulfillment Network [Help Center]
plain_line: Shipping profiles, zones and rates, carrier-calculated rates, shipping labels and insurance, fulfilling orders and routing them to locations, fulfillment services and the Shopify Fulfillment Network, local pickup and delivery, delivery options set by functions, delivery promises and tracking.

platform_names: Payments [settings]; Payments [Help Center]; Shop Pay [Help Center]; Third-party providers [Help Center]; Manual payments [Help Center]; Fraud prevention [Help Center]
plain_line: Which payment methods a store accepts: payment providers and payments apps, Shop Pay and Shop Pay Installments, PayPal, wallets, local and crypto payments, Shop Cash, methods the merchant records outside a provider, saved customer payment methods, authorization and capture, payment customization, and fraud analysis.

platform_names: Shopify Payments [Help Center]; Shopify Payments Terms of Service [legal-agreements]; Shopify Payments eligibility [other:help-center-sections]; Supported countries for Shopify Payments [other:help-center-sections]; Chargebacks and inquiries [Help Center]
plain_line: Shopify's own payment processing: who may use it and in which countries, account setup and verification, the processors and the companies that hold funds and facilitate payments in each region, rates, payouts, reserves and holds, chargebacks and disputes, Shopify Protect, and the businesses it prohibits or restricts.

platform_names: Finance [Help Center]; Finances [Help Center]; Shopify Balance [Help Center]; Shopify Capital [Help Center]; Shopify Credit [Help Center]; Shopify Bill Pay [Help Center]; Financial Products [legal-agreements]
plain_line: Shopify's money products for merchants: the Shopify Balance account and its cards, Shopify Credit, Shopify Capital funding with its lenders in each country, Shopify Bill Pay, and complaints about these products.

platform_names: Taxes and duties [settings]; Taxes [Help Center]; Shopify Tax [Help Center]; Duties and import taxes [Help Center]
plain_line: Sales tax and VAT at checkout, tax registrations and liability, VAT validation and exemptions, tax apps, automated filing, duties and import taxes, and tax forms issued to the merchant.

platform_names: Markets [Help Center]; Markets [settings]; International sales tools [Help Center]; Languages [settings]; Managed Markets [Help Center]; Rollouts [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Selling to other countries and regions with Shopify Markets: languages and translation, the store currency and prices in local currencies, currency conversion, Managed Markets, international domains and geolocation, rollouts and the backup region.

platform_names: Discounts [Help Center]; Discounts [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Discount codes and automatic discounts, and discounts built as functions by apps.

platform_names: Marketing and promotions [Help Center]; Marketing [admin-navigation]; Campaigns [admin-navigation]; Attribution [admin-navigation]; Customer events [settings]; Shopify Audiences [Help Center]; Shopify Collabs [Help Center]
plain_line: Marketing campaigns and automations, Shopify Messaging email and SMS, sales attribution, customer events and pixels, Shopify Audiences, Shop Campaigns, Shopify Collabs, advertising and affiliate apps, product reviews, and loyalty, wishlist and donation apps.

platform_names: Sales channels [settings]; Sales channels [Help Center]; Shop [Help Center]; Marketplaces [Help Center]; Shopify agentic storefronts [Help Center]; Shopify Collective [Help Center]; Custom shopping experiences [Help Center]
plain_line: Where else the store sells: sales channels and publishing to them, the Shop app, marketplaces and their order sync, product feeds, headless and custom storefronts, selling in AI chats, and Shopify Collective.
note: Custom shopping experiences (headless storefronts) is a Help Center menu of its own with one concern; it is joined to Sales channels, as its admin page (CustomStorefronts) is reached as a channel.

platform_names: POS [Help Center]; Point of sale (POS) [Help Center]; Hardware for Shopify POS [Help Center]; POS Equipment Agreement and Return Policies [legal-agreements]
plain_line: Selling in person with Shopify POS: in-person card payments, cash tracking, POS hardware and its equipment agreement in each country, and POS extensions.

platform_names: Analytics [Help Center]; Reports and analytics [Help Center]; Analytics [admin-navigation]; Reports [admin-navigation]; Live View [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Analytics, reports and the live view of store activity.

platform_names: Shopify Flow [Help Center]; AI-powered tools [Help Center]; Sidekick [Help Center]
plain_line: Automating store tasks with Shopify Flow, and Shopify's AI tools: the Sidekick assistant and Shopify Magic text generation for products and blog posts.
note: Joins the Help Center's Shopify Flow and AI-powered tools menus, both tools that act on the store for the merchant, each with few concerns.

platform_names: Apps [Help Center]; Apps [settings]; Shopify App Store [term]; Store management apps [other:app-store-categories]; App development [term]
plain_line: Finding, installing and managing apps and other third-party services, the Shopify App Store and its review of apps, custom apps built in the admin, and accounting, ERP, security and legal apps.
note: Accounting, ERP, security and legal apps are App Store categories under Store management apps with no Shopify feature of their own, so they are joined to Apps.

platform_names: Build & integrate [Help Center]; Shopify API License and Terms of Use [legal-agreements]; Access scopes [api-resources]; Webhooks [api-resources]; Shopify Functions [api-resources]
plain_line: What apps may reach and how: access scopes and the scopes that need Shopify's approval, protected customer data, webhooks including the required privacy webhooks, Shopify Functions, admin and theme app extensions, and the API's versions and limits.
note: Joins the API terms, the API reference's resources and the Partners menu Build & integrate, which together set what apps may do; the merchant-facing app pages are in the Apps area.

platform_names: Partner Program [Help Center]; Partner Directory [Help Center]; Partner Terms of Service [legal-agreements]; Payouts [other:partner-dashboard]
plain_line: The Shopify Partner Program and Partner Dashboard, payouts to partners, and the partners and experts that merchants hire.

platform_names: Privacy and security [Help Center]; Privacy & Data Protection [legal-agreements]; Customer privacy [settings]; Subprocessors [other:help-center-sections]
plain_line: Customer privacy settings and consent, customer data requests and erasure, who controls and who processes the data, where data is stored and sent, subprocessors, legal requests for information, data kept after a store closes, card data security, and Shopify Network Intelligence.

platform_names: Compliance [Help Center]; Merchant Terms of Service [legal-agreements]; 13. Shopify Contracting Party and Forum [legal-agreements]; Acceptable Use Policy [legal-agreements]; Intellectual Property [legal-agreements]; Legal Notices [legal-agreements]
plain_line: The terms a merchant agrees to and the Shopify company it contracts with by billing region, acceptable use and its enforcement, store review, suspension and termination, the merchant's own duties under product and consumer laws, intellectual property reports, and EU and UK platform rules.
note: Joins the Help Center's Compliance menu with the legal agreements that bind every merchant, which no single menu holds.

platform_names: Unsupported countries and regions [other:help-center-sections]; Country/region [term]; Sanctions [term]
plain_line: Where Shopify can be used: the country or region a merchant gives at sign-up, the countries and regions Shopify does not support, and sanctions.
note: No menu names this; it joins the sign-up's country list with the Help Center page on unsupported countries and the sanctions terms, which say where a merchant may use Shopify.
